stage: Phase 7 Stage 6 — Fault Injection & Resilience Testing

scenarios.injected_fault: Black/unobservable blank camera stream (permission denied simulation)
scenarios.recovery_action: Safe degraded fallback with reason code NO_FACE_DETECTED

scenarios.injected_fault: Remote participant video track unsubscribed while session active
scenarios.recovery_action: Immediate reliable safety event emission and watchdog engagement

scenarios.injected_fault: Video stream stalls completely without unsubscribing (>2.0s)
scenarios.recovery_action: Asynchronous frame delivery watchdog transitions state and emits reliable alert

scenarios.injected_fault: Corrupted non-JPEG/PNG byte array passed to image decoder
scenarios.recovery_action: Safe return of IMAGE_DECODE_FAILED DTO, immediate resumption on next valid frame

scenarios.injected_fault: 2.5s frame sampling gap simulating transient network/camera freeze
scenarios.recovery_action: Temporal kinematics detects gap, invalidates in-flight false closure, resets PERCLOS denominator

scenarios.injected_fault: MediaPipe Native C++ graph execution failure (RuntimeError)
scenarios.recovery_action: Caught in _process_frame_locked, face lost handled, session preserved, recovers next frame

scenarios.injected_fault: ONNX Runtime evaluation failure on MobileNetV3 crop verifier
scenarios.recovery_action: Automatic degradation to geometric fallback baseline without crashing pipeline

scenarios.injected_fault: Inference execution latency artificially inflated to 120ms (3x frame interval)
scenarios.recovery_action: Bounded queue depth=1 drops stale frame, increments frames_replaced, retains invariant

scenarios.injected_fault: asyncio.CancelledError injected into inference coroutine while OS worker thread running
scenarios.recovery_action: Preserves frames_in_flight=1 until background OS thread joins, reconciles to frames_aborted
